statement: Build a single-file, phone-friendly website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse and filter products, see sizes, delivery and return details, find the shop, and place orders on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas, plus people looking for the shop's location and timings.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: natural tones, tasteful type, plenty of space
Works well on phones first, no sideways scrolling at 360px or 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Only facts the Requester supplied; no invented products, prices, photos or reviews
rules: Use the Requester's facts exactly as given (names, prices, sizes, hours, numbers, policy)
Product pictures are placeholders until real photos arrive
Nothing is currently on sale, so no sale tags or sale prices
done_when: The site shows the name Thread & Loom and the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005.
The site shows the WhatsApp order number +91 00000 11111 and the shop phone +91 00000 22222, each as a tappable link (WhatsApp link and tel link).
The site shows store timings 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday, closed on Monday.

All 10 products appear with name, category and price: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199; Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999; Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599; Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099.
Each product has an order button that opens a WhatsApp chat to +91 00000 11111 with the product name in the message.
The page has a viewport setting, an earthy colour palette, and no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.
The page runs with no JavaScript errors, filters and category browsing work, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
